authorization: User: first ensure modifications correct, then restart Trepan generation and training.
scope: Trepan only; retain obsolete physics/data/checkpoints unchanged. Nikon/mod3/KLA/SETSUNET unchanged.

data.all_samples: All8bodies perturbed jointly; same noisy9field camera acquisition supplies both20D branches. No isolated-branch image pairing.
data.split: Indices0..6999 train,7000..7499 validation in each cohort; every split uses the same four amplitude modes. No WRMS-based acceptance, easy-case quota or severity-only validation split.
data.mechanics: Reject proposals whose complete nominal-to-sample motion lacks1um glass-envelope clearance. Never project labels/gaps. Exact3D certificate includes tilts and the nested S80/S81 sphere pair.
data.limits_scope: Sampling/command amplitudes, not hardware travel stops. Endpoints can reach twice sample range. Housing and unknown shoulders outside supplied geometry.

optics.fields: Centre plus8source angular azimuths at14.8deg SM-1/2; X/Y scanners fixed. Approximately3.61mm image field.
optics.S71: LE1015 -65.2mm catalog-consistent sign inference, original printed table preserved.
optics.method: Global rigid-body poses; cached unchanged upstream relay; explicit launch phase+OPL+fixed3D100mm reference sphere. No finite-object waveabr, mutable shared-gap overwrite or automatic aperture resizing.

observation.relay: Modelled ideal pupil relay from6mm source coordinates to2mm camera pupil;2mm propagation,4mm sensor width; fixed diffuser. This calibration relay is not claimed as paper hardware.
observation.integration: degree16 continuous phase fit independently checked per capture,1024 pupil/2048 FFT,integrated pixels,physical tilt kept in carrier propagator
observation.noise: Single nominal fixed exposure, fixed PRNU0.5% and DSNU2+/-0.5e maps; independent Poisson shot and1.2e read noise;10000e full well,4ADU/e,100ADU offset,quantized. No per-frame peak normalization.
observation.normalization: Training-only mean camera frame; fixed scaling, no per-image amplitude renormalization.

network.architecture: ArchA image backbone plus raw noisy8x8patch nodes, cross-attention and8body self-attention shared across front/rear; two groups of four5D heads
network.initialization: Fresh weights and zero output heads; old low-NA inverse map is not resumed.
network.inference: Exactly one forward pass, command=-tanh(prediction) times physical scales, full40D action. No oracle line search/endpoint truth clipping; infeasible command paths count as failures.

training.schedule: Train front/rear heads together for50joint epochs over14000training observations, instead of50isolated-front plus50isolated-rear runs. Each branch receives whole-assembly optical loss; no second acquisition or feedback.
training.loss: Centre absolute PTTD WRMS, bounded log1p(r^2)/(1+log1p(r^2)),r=WRMS/0.07; plus0.05pose loss and10mechanical barrier. Invalid optical/whole-command-path samples have optical penalty>=2 while valid optical loss<1. Exact nonlinear float64 trace gradients, no target oracle during inference.
training.selection: Largest whole-system validation centre<0.07 pass count, then lower P90,then mean; epoch0eligible. Invalids remain denominator failures.
training.curves: Epoch0..50: loss components, fixed500train probe,1000validation one-shot recovery,mean/P90centre,nine-field mean,invalids;CSV,JSON,PNG,PDF.
training.resume: Atomic model/optimizer/RNG,minibatch progress every20batches; deterministic epoch permutation. Preserve source fingerprint.

final_checks: Joint1000validation endpoints;24fixed endpoint cases independently replayed through full NumPy85surface path at3fields plus scalar RayOptics;129grid centre score for all1000 with threshold disagreements retained.
reporting: Validation is used for checkpoint selection, not an independent test set. Program completion is separate from assistant review. No automatic deployment/push or notifications. Effective elapsed time excludes standby.
